resources.string: A little order.\nA lot of space.
Your files, your device. No account needed.
No visible files in this folder.
This folder is unavailable or Android has restricted access. Try another folder or check file access.
More matching items are available. This alpha still enumerates the whole folder; the display limit is 100,000.
This file cannot be opened. Check access and whether a compatible app is installed.
Android file-access settings are not available on this device.
Android requires your permission to browse shared storage and use local copy/folder creation. SAF read access is selected separately. Restricted folders remain protected.
No ads, analytics or mandatory account. This build has no Internet permission. The external app you choose to open a file has its own privacy policy.

Alpha 0.12 · Local/SAF browsing, search within a folder, persistent sort/hidden preferences, saved folder favorites, selection and local/SAF folder creation. Copy local or SAF sources to local storage; files/folders can also be copied to writable SAF. Actual SAF rename after confirmation. No move or deletion; not a final version.
Still to implement: move/delete and local rename with safeguards, recycle bin, global search, archives, internal readers, cloud/NAS, sharing and optional Shizuku.
Read-only connections retain READ only. Choose the separate read/write connection to create folders. No all-files permission is needed for SAF. The provider may use its own network.
Forget Cantas access to this folder? No file will be deleted. Choose it again in Android to reconnect.
Requested access could not be retained. Choose the folder again and confirm access.
Android’s folder picker is not available on this device.
This connected folder is unavailable. Check the card or USB connection and Android access, or choose the folder again.
Folder connections could not be read or changed. Try again; access may still be retained.
Create one local folder here. Existing files and folders will never be replaced. Writable SAF connections use a separate provider operation.
Use 1–255 UTF-8 bytes, no surrounding spaces, slash, backslash, control characters, dot or dot-dot.
This name is already used. Choose another name; nothing was replaced.
Folder creation is not allowed here. Check Android write access.
The destination is no longer available. Close this dialog and refresh.
This provider does not advertise folder creation for this directory.
The folder could not be created. Check access, free space and the name; refresh before retrying.
Folder created: %1$s. Current filters or the display limit may hide it.
%1$d items staged. Navigate to a local destination folder.

Local or authorized SAF sources to LOCAL storage only. Folder contents include hidden items regardless of filters. Up to 100 roots, 1,000 entries, depth 32. Unknown SAF file lengths are capped at 512 MiB per file; exceeding this leaves an unverified partial output. Choose a separate destination: opaque SAF IDs cannot prove physical disjointness. Existing names are skipped, folders NEVER merged. Originals are opened read-only. Partial outputs remain; no automatic cleanup. A cloud provider may download data under its own policies.
Cancellation stops after the current blocking read/write returns. Originals are kept; partial outputs are not deleted.

This operation was interrupted or its journal/access could not be verified. Requested names below may already have existed. Inspect the destination manually; files may be incomplete. Nothing is retried or deleted automatically.
Some newly created outputs are incomplete or unverified. Inspect the destination: providers may use different names. Do not treat them as completed copies.
Source changed or size differs — unverified
Failed — inspect any newly created output
Closing clears this private report only. It does not remove any source or destination file.
Local write access was not granted. No file operation was started.
Local or writable SAF destination: up to 100 roots, 1,000 entries, depth 32. Local or authorized SAF sources.
Folder created — see child results, not a completion guarantee
Preparation stopped or refused before destination creation: check access, names, links/types, limits and destination (never inside the source). No destination entry was created.
Save this folder as a favorite

Up to 50 folders and 256 KiB of private metadata. Favorites store shortcuts only, not files or access rights. Access is checked again when opened. Rename changes the shortcut title only (1–128 characters).
No favorite folders yet. Use the star in a folder to save it.
SAF folder — its original read grant is required.
Remove only this saved shortcut? No file is deleted and no Android access is revoked.
Saved folders or browse preferences could not be loaded/saved (limits or storage error). Your current view may not be saved. Open Favorites to retry or explicitly reset this metadata.
Reset saved folders and browse preferences
Erase all favorite shortcuts and reset sorting/hidden-file preferences? This changes only Cantas private metadata, not user files, URI grants, clipboard or theme.

Create one folder using the selected provider. Existing names are refused when detected. The provider can change names or fail after creation: uncertain outputs are kept; inspect and refresh before retrying. No automatic cleanup.
Creation could not be verified. A folder may already exist, possibly under another name. Refresh and inspect before trying again; nothing is automatically deleted.

Up to 100 roots, 1,000 entries, depth 32, including hidden files and empty folders. Existing folders are NEVER merged. Detected names are refused. Provider changes/failures may leave partial or differently named outputs: inspect before retrying. Sources are not deleted. Content rereads can use extra cloud traffic and do not prove provider durability.
Unverified provider output — inspect before retrying

This changes the actual SAF file or folder name, not a favorite shortcut. Detected collisions are refused, but provider rename is not atomic against other apps. A failure can mean the name already changed. Inspect before retrying; no automatic rollback. Saved favorites and clipboard names are not rewritten.
Rename verified. Close to view the refreshed folder.
This provider does not advertise rename for this item.
The item, parent or metadata changed or is unavailable. Close, refresh and select again.
Rename could not be verified. The name or URI may already have changed. Close and inspect the parent before trying again; no automatic rollback.
